title: Pop Mart Labubu Blind Box Set
words: Pop Mart Labubu blind box collectible vinyl toy shop cute pastel
style: glossy soft 3D vinyl designer-toy render like a Pop Mart shop display, rounded chunky shapes, pastel candy colors, soft studio light from the top left, gentle rim light, clean and premium

frame.scene: the inside of a cozy pastel Pop Mart toy shop seen straight on: a soft pink back wall with rounded arched shelves of small toy boxes softly out of focus at the far left and right edges, a warm cream counter at the bottom
frame.focal: one sealed pastel blind box with a satin ribbon on top, glowing softly, standing on a round cream display pedestal, with a small Labubu figure (a cute furry elf-monster with tall bunny ears and a toothy grin) peeking out
frame.hud: one wide blank pink rounded score plaque at the very top
frame.controls: a 3 by 3 grid of empty rounded collection-book slots on a cream card panel

backdrop.scene: a cozy pastel toy-shop wall with arched shelves of small toy boxes kept at the far left and right edges, a soft pink middle wall with gentle light, a cream counter at the bottom
backdrop.calm: the middle third of the width from top to bottom is a soft, plain pink wall with gentle gradient light

sprites.set: Subjects 1 to 9 are nine different Labubu figures of one collectible blind-box series: the same character (a cute furry elf-monster with tall pointed bunny ears, big round eyes and a wide toothy grin, standing upright), each with its own fur color and outfit exactly as described, all in the same pose and size, no two alike.

items.text: Coco Labubu: cocoa brown fur, cream overalls
Berry Labubu: raspberry red fur, a strawberry hat
Mint Labubu: pale mint fur, a little white apron
Lilac Labubu: lavender fur, a starry wizard cape
Peach Labubu: peach orange fur, a peach-slice pouch
Sky Labubu: sky blue fur, a cloud scarf
Rose Labubu: rose pink fur, a ballet tutu
Coral Labubu: coral fur, a striped sailor shirt
Gold Labubu, the secret figure: shiny metallic gold fur, a tiny crown, sparkles
a sealed pastel blind box: a cube box in pink and cream halves with a satin mint ribbon bow on top and an embossed bunny-ear silhouette on the front
an empty rounded-square collection-book slot: a soft cream recessed pocket with a stitched pink edge, seen straight on
a shiny round pastel gold trade token coin with a raised star in the middle

ui.material: glossy pastel candy plastic: a cream-white face with a thick rounded raspberry-pink rim and a soft inner highlight
ui.button: a thicker darker pink lower lip so it looks pressable

wordmark.lettering: puffy rounded glossy vinyl-toy letters in cream and candy pink with a thick raspberry outline and soft white highlights, bouncy and cute like a Pop Mart blind-box logo
